fusions.name: Quiet Quill
fusions.desc: Slips a quill into the first enemy it meets for 4 damage. Its first strike on an unwounded target has 50% more critical chance.

fusions.name: Slipped Edge
fusions.desc: Slips a talon under the target's guard for 30 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The blow ignores its resistances.

fusions.name: Sharpened Resolve
fusions.desc: Your critical hits deal 40% more damage for 12 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Follow-Through
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
